
DESCRIPTION
Create a workspace

USAGE
  one create [dir] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one create demo
  one create . --name demo
  one create demo --yes

TIPS
Creates an empty workspace. Run one add to add a project.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -n, --name <value>       Workspace name (default: target directory name)
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  -y, --yes                Use defaults without prompting

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  --preset <value>         Automation preset ID; implies --yes and may create projects
  --project-names <value>  Comma-separated project names for --preset expansion
